mapper.sql: select s.school_id, s.school_name, s.school_name_en, s.country, s.city, s.rankings, s.moe_recognized, s.website, s.status, s.del_flag, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.remark, (select count(*) from abr_program p where p.school_id = s.school_id and p.del_flag = '0') as program_count from abr_school s
mapper.select: where s.country = #{country} and s.school_name_en = #{schoolNameEn} and s.del_flag = '0' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into abr_school (school_name, school_name_en, country, city, rankings, moe_recognized, website, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{schoolName}, #{schoolNameEn}, #{country}, coalesce(#{city}, ''), coalesce(cast(#{rankings} as jsonb), '[]'::jsonb), coalesce(#{moeRecognized}, 'Y'), coalesce(#{website}, ''), coalesce(#{status}, '0'), #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update abr_school set school_name = #{schoolName}, school_name_en = #{schoolNameEn}, country = #{country}, city = coalesce(#{city}, ''), rankings = coalesce(cast(#{rankings} as jsonb), '[]'::jsonb), moe_recognized = coalesce(#{moeRecognized}, 'Y'), website = coalesce(#{website}, ''), status = coalesce(#{status}, '0'), remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where school_id = #{schoolId} and del_flag = '0'
